title: Dribble-Skill-Pass 1
setup: Several lines with 3 cones each so you have 3 players per line. If your team has 12 players you will need 4 lines. Cones are 10 yards apart. One ball per line. Two players on one side, one player on the other.
instructions: The player with the ball dribbles with the laces toward the middle cone, performs a designated skill move, takes a touch to the side, and passes to the opposite player.
He then follows the pass and runs to the opposite side.
The receiver does a good first touch, and repeats the process in the other direction.
coachingPoints: Dribble with the laces, toes pointing down, small quick touches.
Do the designated move early - don't get too close to the middle cone (=defender).
Take a touch straight to the side to create space to pass.
Make an accurate pass (swing your passing leg straight toward the target player).
Spring to the opposite line (take the place of the receiver).
Skills: 1. touch to the side; 2. side step; 3. scissors; 4. step-over; 5. Iniesta; 6. pull-push; 7. pull-cut

derived.areaSize: cones set 10 yards apart per line
